description: Configuration class for Fineract Feign client, including HTTP client setup, SSL handling, and client creation logic.

classes.name: FineractFeignClientConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for creating and managing Feign clients with customizable HTTP settings.

classes.name: FineractFeignClientConfig.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing FineractFeignClientConfig instances with custom parameters.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a Feign client instance for the specified API interface.

methods.name: getOrCreateHttpClient
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the cached HTTP client.

methods.name: createHttpClient
methods.description: Creates an HTTP client based on the configured client type (Apache or OkHttp).

methods.name: createApacheHttpClient
methods.description: Builds an Apache HTTP client with optional SSL verification disabling.

methods.name: createOkHttpClient
methods.description: Builds an OkHttp client with optional SSL verification disabling.

methods.name: createTrustAllManager
methods.description: Creates a TrustManager that trusts all certificates.

methods.name: createTrustAllSslContext
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext that trusts all certificates.
